title: The starting files

blocks.what_we_do: Identify the complete laboratory export and keep an immutable input copy.
blocks.why: A binary genotype matrix is interpreted using its variant and sample files. Matching counts alone cannot detect reordered identities. The simulated initial data include low-quality wells and variants deliberately retained for QC; they are starting inputs, not an already cleaned analysis cohort.
blocks.you_need: Module 0 passed; the module 1 export inspection.
blocks.command:
```{r s2-1}
print(check_bed(cfg$input))
head(read_fam(cfg$input))
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable: no PLINK operation is needed for this R-only or laboratory step. The R chunk is the complete command; PLINK cannot perform a laboratory measurement.

R reads or calculates the displayed values without changing the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
2,016 sample wells and 299,523 variant entries before QC. Each well has its own FID/IID pair.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks and available instructor reference counts passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
Why must the FAM stay with the BED and BIM?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>
